purpose: Freeze the primary-stream nuisance-process measurement formula and the pre-scoring reference-zone binding rule while leaving effect-risk calibration and nuisance decision thresholds to the separate operational calibration gate.

measurement_code.input: grayscale primary-stream frames in [0,255], focal zone, prebound disjoint reference zones

required_binding: one or more spatially disjoint reference_zones
reference_manifest.actual per-window coordinates remain par: split_blinding_protocol remains a separate blocker until those entries are frozen

frozen_measurement.motion_trace: frame-to-frame mean absolute grayscale change per ROI divided by 255
frozen_measurement.reference_trace: pointwise median across reference-zone motion traces
frozen_measurement.positive_correlation: positive part of centered cosine/Pearson-equivalent correlation; flat traces return 0
frozen_measurement.amplitude_agreement: 2 * min(focal_rms, reference_rms) / (focal_rms + reference_rms), with zero for no motion
frozen_measurement.reference_stationarity: 1 - absolute first-half/second-half RMS difference divided by their sum
frozen_measurement.reference_spectral_concentration: maximum non-DC power fraction of centered reference trace

hard_boundaries: target-driven focal-only motion is not promoted to exogenous nuisance without reference motion
Pearson correlation alone is insufficient because amplitude agreement is required
static focal/reference agreement is not positive nuisance-process evidence
the nuisance_process_index is not a probability
the nuisance_process_index is not yet false_event_risk, missed_event_risk, or attribution_risk
no nuisance decision threshold is frozen by this artifact
